title: Boyle syringe comparison
script:
new
add v1 N2 0.01mol @ 25C
add v2 N2 0.01mol @ 25C
seal v1 100mL
seal v2 200mL
measure v1 pressure
measure v2 pressure
inspect
expectation: Equal gas doses at equal temperature produce twice the absolute pressure in half the headspace.
criteria: Pressure excess above any explicitly documented ambient background has ratio 2 within 2%; gas inventory unchanged.

title: Dalton mixed inert gases
script:
new
add v1 N2 0.005mol @ 25C
add v1 Ar 0.005mol @ 25C
add v2 N2 0.01mol @ 25C
seal v1 100mL
seal v2 100mL
measure v1 pressure
measure v2 pressure
inspect
expectation: Equal total gas moles have equal ideal pressure regardless of inert composition.
criteria: Pressure agreement within 2%; both gases retained in mixed vessel.

title: Kelvin scaling of pressure
script:
new
add v1 Ar 0.01mol @ 25C
add v2 Ar 0.01mol @ 75C
seal v1 100mL
seal v2 100mL
measure v1 pressure
measure v2 pressure
measure v1 thermometer
measure v2 thermometer
inspect
expectation: Absolute pressure scales with Kelvin temperature, 348.15/298.15, not Celsius ratio.
criteria: Measured temperature within 1K of doses; gas pressure contribution ratio within 2% of 1.16770.

title: Piston volume from ideal gas law
script:
add v1 Ar 0.01mol @ 25C
regulate v1 1bar 100mL
measure v1 pressure
measure v1 volume
inspect
expectation: A pressure-regulated gas piston settles to nRT/P, approximately 247.9mL for 0.01mol at 298.15K and 1bar.
criteria: Pressure is 1bar and gas volume 247.9mL within 2%, or explicit unsupported observable refusal rather than a false liquid volume.

title: Double gas dose at same piston pressure
script:
new
add v1 Ar 0.01mol @ 25C
add v2 Ar 0.02mol @ 25C
regulate v1 1bar 100mL
regulate v2 1bar 100mL
measure v1 volume
measure v2 volume
inspect
expectation: Doubling inert gas moles doubles regulated gas volume.
criteria: Stored boundary or gas volume doubles within 2%; pressure equal, inventories 0.01 and 0.02mol.

title: Venting releases compression
script:
add v1 N2 0.01mol
seal v1 100mL
measure v1 pressure
open v1
measure v1 pressure
inspect
expectation: Opening removes imposed compression and exchanges gas with the environment.
criteria: Final pressure ambient or explicit open-boundary indication; no sealed overpressure remains.

title: Hydrogen pop positive
script:
add v1 H2 0.001mol
seal v1 100mL
test v1 pop
inspect
expectation: Hydrogen headspace gives a positive pop test; test should not produce oxygen spontaneously.
criteria: Positive hydrogen response with no unexplained atom creation.

title: Helium pop negative
script:
add v1 He 0.001mol
seal v1 100mL
test v1 pop
inspect
expectation: Helium is inert and cannot give the hydrogen pop response.
criteria: Explicit negative pop test; helium inventory remains finite and nonnegative.

title: Oxygen glowing splint positive
script:
add v1 O2 0.001mol
seal v1 100mL
test v1 splint
inspect
expectation: Oxygen supports combustion and relights a glowing splint.
criteria: Positive oxygen test, no hydrogen-specific response.

title: Nitrogen glowing splint negative
script:
add v1 N2 0.001mol
seal v1 100mL
test v1 splint
inspect
expectation: Nitrogen cannot relight a glowing splint.
criteria: Negative splint test.

title: Carbon dioxide limewater positive
script:
add v1 CO2 0.001mol
seal v1 100mL
test v1 limewater
inspect
expectation: Carbon dioxide clouds limewater via carbonate formation.
criteria: Positive limewater response, no false oxygen interpretation.

title: Argon limewater negative
script:
add v1 Ar 0.001mol
seal v1 100mL
test v1 limewater
inspect
expectation: Argon does not cloud limewater.
criteria: Negative limewater response.

title: Ammonia damp litmus basic
script:
add v1 NH3 0.001mol
seal v1 100mL
test v1 litmus
inspect
expectation: Ammonia gas dissolves on damp litmus and gives an alkaline response.
criteria: Basic blue response, or explicit unsupported ammonia test refusal; neither acidic nor neutral claimed.

title: Dry silica versus salt conductivity
script:
new
add v1 H2O 100mL
add v1 SiO2 1g
add v2 H2O 100mL
add v2 NaCl 0.001mol
measure v1 conductivity
measure v2 conductivity
inspect
expectation: Insoluble silica does not generate a strong electrolyte; sodium chloride solution is much more conductive.
criteria: Salt conductivity exceeds silica control by at least an order of magnitude, or explicit missing conductivity fit for silica.

title: Neutral sucrose versus ionic salt
script:
new
add v1 H2O 100mL
add v1 Sucrose 0.001mol
add v2 H2O 100mL
add v2 NaCl 0.001mol
measure v1 conductivity
measure v2 conductivity
inspect
expectation: Sucrose dissolves as neutral molecules, while NaCl dissociates into charge carriers.
criteria: Salt conductivity exceeds sugar control by at least tenfold, or explicit unsupported sugar conductivity refusal.

title: Tenfold electrolyte dilution
script:
add v1 H2O 100mL
add v1 NaCl 0.001mol
measure v1 conductivity
dilute v1 900mL
measure v1 conductivity
inspect
expectation: Dilution preserves salt amount and lowers conductivity; dilute-limit conductivity approximately tracks concentration.
criteria: Salt atom budgets unchanged; final conductivity lower, ratio between0.05 and0.2 if quantitative fit exists.

title: Cooling inert solid without phase crossing
script:
add v1 Fe 1mol @ 100C
measure v1 thermometer
cool v1 1kJ
measure v1 thermometer
measure v1 balance
inspect
expectation: One kJ removed from one mole iron lowers its temperature tens of kelvin without changing material mass.
criteria: Temperature decreases by20–60K; Fe amount1mol and mass55.8g conserved within1%.

title: Two-stage sensible heat cycle
script:
add v1 Cu 1mol @ 25C
measure v1 thermometer
heat v1 500J
cool v1 500J
measure v1 thermometer
measure v1 balance
inspect
expectation: Adding then removing equal heat below any phase transition returns copper to its starting state.
criteria: Final temperature25C within0.2K; amount1mol and mass63.55g within1%.

title: Energy split invariance for copper
script:
new
add v1 Cu 1mol @ 25C
add v2 Cu 1mol @ 25C
heat v1 600J
heat v2 200J
heat v2 400J
measure v1 thermometer
measure v2 thermometer
inspect
expectation: Without a phase crossing or reactions, splitting the same total input energy leaves the same final state.
criteria: Final temperatures agree within0.2K; identical copper inventory.

title: Equivalent molar and gram dose
script:
new
add v1 Fe 1mol
add v2 Fe 55.845g
measure v1 balance
measure v2 balance
particles v1
particles v2
inspect
expectation: Mass and mole input units describe the same iron inventory within atomic-weight rounding.
criteria: Both masses55.845g within0.1%, both amounts1mol within0.1%; particle reports consistent.
